cues.text: Chidori's hospital room. Chidori sits up in bed, and Junpei stands beside her holding a new sketchbook.
Junpei sets the sketchbook on the bedside table and sits down on the stool next to her. Across the room, Mitsuru sits in a chair with her arms crossed, and Akihiko stands near her, watching.

In a burst of sparks, a figure rises out of Chidori: a long-limbed shape with a mane of fiery hair. It crouches over her on the bed with its arms around her. Akihiko, Mitsuru and Shinjiro hurry to the bedside.
Shinjiro pushes past to Chidori, takes out a syringe and injects her arm. The figure fades away, and Chidori slumps, gasping for breath.
Shinjiro walks out of the room.
Mitsuru leaves the room too, and Junpei is left alone with Chidori.
